description: X5.13: rotary triple inverted pendulum on the spatial multibond stdlib (NOT a Quanser product: the arm, the SRV02 servo and the pendulum links of the Quanser rotary double pendulum, chained short + short + medium). World -> Mount -> J1 (Revolute3D about world z, the arm) -> arm bar (RigidBody3D) -> J2, J3, J4 (Revolute3D about the arm axis, one per link), every body a RigidBody3D with a distributed mass (COM at the bar middle). The arm is driven by an SRV02-like servo with a 15 V amplifier: Motor (ElectricDrive, voltage input) -> Shaft (ElasticShaft) -> Gear (IdealGear, 70:1) -> J1.drive. The 1 kHz firmware Ctrl (phases: idle, discrete TVLQR swing-up along the collocation trajectory, latched discrete LQR balance) reads the joint angles and rates. Dist is a force pulse on the tip of the top link. Joint compliance kt = kr = 1e8 (N/m, N m/rad); every state is integral.

checks.note: no derivative-causality warning, no event-loop warning, no solver failure
at rest before t_on: the arm does not move (motor voltage 0). Bound: 5x the measured start-up residual of the released joint compliance
hanging straight down before t_on (link 1 at pi); 2 mrad is larger than the measured joint sag
controller idle before t_on
motor voltage 0 before t_on
the balance controller has taken over one second after t_on + T_s
upright reached by t_on + T_s + 0.5 s = 5.5 s: every link within 1.0 deg (measured settled band 0.00 deg)
all link angles inside 1.0 deg of upright between catch + 1.5 s and the disturbance (measured max 0.00 deg; the bound is 2x, at least 1 deg)
the disturbance is real: the tip link deflects by 3.5 deg (design.py: 3.5 deg); accepted band +-30 %
recovered: back inside 1.0 deg from 10.4863 s (measured: inside 0.5 deg after 1.35 s)
the motor voltage never exceeds the +-15 V amplifier limit (clamped in the firmware; measured peak 14.15 V)
the arm stays inside +-2.7 rad: the bound of the swing-up trajectory (2.5 rad) plus 0.2 rad for the feedback (measured max 2.500 rad)
